headline: Deputy Finance Minister: Energy Subsidy Policy Will Continue to Be Improved
summary: Deputy Finance Minister Juda Agung said the energy subsidy policy will continue to be improved so that it becomes more precisely targeted. The statement was made in Jakarta.
why: Energy subsidies affect Indonesia's state budget and fuel prices, which matter for inflation, the rupiah and the country's fiscal outlook.
